mapper.select: SELECT m.member_number AS doctorNumber , m.member_name AS doctorName , NVL(d.department_code, '진료') AS deptName FROM member m INNER JOIN authority a ON a.member_number = m.member_number AND a.permission_name IN ('ROLE_DOCTOR') LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.member_number = m.member_number LEFT JOIN department d ON e.department_code = d.department_code ORDER BY d.department_name, m.member_name

SELECT a.appointment_number AS appointmentNumber , a.member_number AS memberNumber , m.member_name AS patientName , m.member_phone_number AS phone , SUBSTR(m.resident_registration_number, 1, 6) AS birthDate , a.attending_physician AS doctorNumber , dm.member_name AS doctorName , TO_CHAR(a.reservation_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reserveDate , TO_CHAR(a.reservation_start_date, 'HH24:MI') AS reserveTime , TO_CHAR(a.reservation_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS startAt , TO_CHAR(NVL(a.reservation_end_date, a.reservation_start_date + 30/1440) , 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS endAt , a.reservation_status AS status , a.symptoms AS symptoms , NVL(a.color, '#3788d8') AS color FROM appointment a INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_number = a.member_number LEFT JOIN member dm ON dm.member_number = a.attending_physician WHERE a.appointment_number = #{appointmentNumber}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APPOINTMENT WHERE ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN = #{doctorNumber} AND RESERVATION_STATUS = '예약확정' AND RESERVATION_START_DATE < TO_DATE(#{reserveAt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') + #{durationMinutes}/1440 AND NVL(RESERVATION_END_DATE, RESERVATION_START_DATE + 30/1440) > TO_DATE(#{reserveAt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')
AND appointment_number != #{excludeNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE APPOINTMENT SET RESERVATION_STATUS = '예약취소' WHERE APPOINTMENT_NUMBER = #{appointmentNumber} AND RESERVATION_STATUS = '예약확정'
UPDATE APPOINTMENT SET RESERVATION_STATUS = '접수완료' WHERE APPOINTMENT_NUMBER = #{appointmentNumber} AND RESERVATION_STATUS = '예약확정'
UPDATE APPOINTMENT SET RESERVATION_STATUS = '예약취소' WHERE RESERVATION_STATUS = '예약확정' AND RESERVATION_START_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE)
